messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T Canaan Avalon Q

Honestly? The Avalon Q isn't the one I'd start on. It's $1,349, pulls 1,670W and can hit 65 dB — that's a garage machine, not a first miner.

For a first unit I'd point you at the Magic Miner 40T at $799 (40 TH/s, ~650W, ~50 dB in Eco) or the Harlo B30 at $899 (30 TH/s, ~360-450W, ~50 dB).

Where would it actually sit — living space, or somewhere you don't mind noise?
